_comment: How each boss is simmed. Keys are WCL encounter ids or boss names; 'default' covers the rest. style is any simc fight_style (Patchwerk, CastingPatchwerk, HecticAddCleave, LightMovement, HeavyMovement, DungeonSlice, Beastlord); targets sets desired_targets; extra takes raw simc lines. max_time always comes from the real kill, so it isn't set here.
